in_sanskrit.name: नरायण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: नर (man) + आयण (lord, ruler) => नरायण (Lord of all beings)

in_tamil.name: நராயண
in_tamil.meaning: ஜீவத்தின் அடிகள் வழிக்கையர் (Lord of all beings)
in_tamil.long_meaning: நர் (man) + ஆய்ண (lord, ruler) => நராயண (Lord of all beings)

in_telugu.name: నరాయణ
in_telugu.long_meaning: నర్ (man) + ఆయేశ్ (lord, ruler) => నరాయణ (Lord of all beings)

in_marathi.name: Narayana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Narayana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Narayana is a revered deity in Hinduism, known as the supreme god and the preserver of the universe. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nara' meaning man and 'Ayan' meaning to give or to protect. Thus, Narayana represents the divine protector and savior of mankind.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Narayana একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Narayana is a revered deity in Hinduism, known as the supreme god and the preserver of the universe. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nara' meaning man and 'Ayan' meaning to give or to protect. Thus, Narayana represents the divine protector and savior of mankind.
